description: The CLI success text tells the user to 'Set a passphrase in the console under Settings', but the console sidebar has no Settings entry (Files, Agents, API keys, Usage, Trash, Billing & limits, Activity & deletion). The only route is a small 'Set up' link in the Files header.
expected: CLI wording names a control the user can see.
actual: CLI says 'Settings'; console shows 'Set up' link in the Files header and no Settings nav item.
suggested_fix: Change the CLI text to 'click Set up on the Files page' or add a Settings nav item.

description: Footer text 'You can revoke access any time in Console, Agents.' is plain text, not a link, on both the approval form and nothing on the done card links to Agents.
expected: A link to the Agents page.

description: If AGENT_DRIVE_API_URL lacks the /api suffix, the CLI prints only 'Agent Drive refused the login request: 404' with no hint about the URL.
expected: Message names the URL it called or says the API URL should end in /api.
actual: Agent Drive refused the login request: 404
suggested_fix: Include the requested URL and a hint when the response is a 404 HTML page.

description: The approval-saved card does not say that the CLI will finish by itself within seconds or that the request lifetime is 10 minutes; a user who sees no change in the terminal has no reference.
expected: One line such as 'Your agent will finish in a few seconds.'
actual: 'Return to your agent to finish setup and confirm it is ready.'
suggested_fix: Add the expected wait to the done text.
